subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Ler e compreender, com autonomia, anedotas, piadas e cartuns, dentre outros gêneros do campo da vida cotidiana, de acordo com as convenções do gênero e considerando a situação comunicativa e a finalidade do texto.

components.description_pt: Ler e compreender anedotas de forma independente, reconhecendo convenções do gênero e propósito comunicativo
components.description_en: Read and comprehend anecdotes independently, recognizing genre conventions and communicative purpose
components.cc_component_description: Identify how genre conventions shape an author's treatment of a shared subject

components.description_pt: Ler e compreender piadas de forma independente, considerando situação comunicativa e propósito
components.description_en: Read and comprehend jokes independently, considering communicative situation and purpose
components.cc_component_description: Read and comprehend stories at the grades 6–8 text complexity band with appropriate scaffolding

cc_matches.description: By the end of the year, read and comprehend literature, including stories, dramas, and poems, in the grades 6—8 text complexity band proficiently, with scaffolding as needed at the high end of the range.
Compare and contrast texts in different forms or genres (e.g., stories and poems; historical novels and fantasy stories) in terms of their approaches to similar themes and topics.
